title: Cookie Clicker
description: An interactive, unblocked retro gaming hub loaded directly via Google Apps Script macro channel. Run emulators, custom web scripts, and instant-play web compilations.
controls: Use Keyboard ARROW keys or WASD, standard interaction cursor, or specific on-screen control bindings provided inside the web frame portal.

title: Dig out of Prison
description: A second interactive vintage portal featuring classic emulator modes, lightweight custom HTML canvas animations, and quick web games hosted inside the clean Apps Script sandbox.
controls: Use Keyboard ARROW keys, WASD, Spacebar, or simple mouse cursors to interact with the game window viewport.

title: BitLife
description: Unleash infinite choices in an interactive life simulator sandbox. Make decisions, start relationships, build status, and discover the diverse outcomes and paths your virtual self can lead.
controls: Click to select life events, answer prompts, navigate interfaces, and manage status attributes inside the clean sandbox portal frame.
